column1: # Split git layout file-writer census (Wave B PR 5 lane 5e, spec §9 option B). test/split-layout-writer-census.test.ts counts each src file's file write primitives and its calls to the repo's write helpers (split-layout-write-helpers.tsv), comment lines excluded.

# Classes (option B, one predicate): door (writes under the publication door or moves whole checkout trees), refuse_before_write (refuses a page in a split unit, or one that would become a split head, before its first database or file write),

# not_page_path (provably never writes a syncable page path: a fixed non-.md name, gbrain home, a temporary or private scratch file, a dot folder sync prunes). No other class exists: only the strict door on a git-canonical source writes a split page.

# A refuse_before_write writer names the split-unit predicate (split-unit-guard.ts assertSplitUnitMutable or assertSplitUnitMutableSync) or a split-write-through.ts wrapper of it (assertOutsideDoorWritable, outsideDoorRefusal, assertOneFileWritable) on the page it writes; "via <path>[, <path>]:" names the classified helper modules that run it for every write; "no helper:" says why neither applies.

# A not_page_path row of a file that names a .md file starts "md:" and says why that file is never a syncable page. Parts-directory checks outside the split modules are reviewed in split-layout-parts-dir-readers.tsv.
